remarks: Move-in ready and ideally situated in one of Moorpark's most sought-after neighborhoods, this is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy comfortable living, great amenities, and a fantastic location all in one place. This bright and spacious end-unit attached-home offers a versatile floor plan featuring a convenient main-floor bedroom and bath, a private upstairs ensuite bedroom, and a third bedroom/loft , ideal for guests, a home office, or additional living space. Thoughtfully updated throughout, this expansive home showcases newer laminate flooring, refreshed interior paint, crown molding, and an upgraded kitchen with beautiful white cabinetry, updated countertops, gas stove, built-in microwave
